title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Prompt Log. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Prompt Log
options.lineage: the AI chat transcript: role-tagged turns, model labels, token counts, timestamps — the era's native document
options.thesis: The portfolio is the conversation that shipped: every product a turn in the log, and the visitor reads the evidence in the format the AI era actually records.
options.viewport: A session already in progress: the SYSTEM turn states the name, role and CAN DO tagline, the implied visitor question hangs above a logged reply whose first turns are the shipped products, and impact metrics render as telemetry lines with real figures.
options.risk: A literal chat skin risks tool-monoculture; every element must read as the log at data density, not a fake chat window.

options.label: Nixie Laboratory Counter
options.lineage: nixie-tube lab counters: stacked glass-envelope digits, engraved panel caps, blackened steel chassis
options.thesis: The career as an instrument rack: each metric owns a tube bank, each product a calibrated panel, and the numbers glow as physical plasma.
options.viewport: An instrument rack: the hero name engraved on the top panel, impact metrics as glowing tube banks, each product a rack module with its own calibration plate.
options.risk: Memorable and precise; risks reading as a lab relic unless the motion of cross-fading digits commits fully.
options.case: Wins identity with the engineering audience — numbers as instruments is exactly how AI engineers verify claims; keeps figures legible for clients.

options.label: Data Sublime
options.lineage: Ikeda-style datamatics: dense barcode columns, sine lattices, monospace numerics, pure black and white
options.thesis: The work as a data field: barcode columns and sine lattices at full density, numbers packed in tabular columns, and the occasional full-frame inversion.
options.viewport: A black field of hairline bars and monospace columns; the name is set in dense data type, products scan as barcode fields, metrics read from tabular columns.
options.risk: The most audacious card, and the coldest: non-technical clients may not find the product story behind the data sublime.
options.case: Beats every card on memorability and the AI-data mood; fuses poorly on product clarity — installed software is not a barcode.

options.label: Stenberg Poster
options.lineage: Stenberg brothers film posters: photomontage scale jumps, racing constructivist caps, one violent diagonal
options.thesis: The career as a film bill: scale jumps make the shipped work loom, type races along the diagonal, and the page tilts with each chapter.
options.viewport: A full-bleed bill: the name set huge on the tilt, each product a montage element scaled by impact, the CAN DO tagline wedged into the composition.
options.risk: Maximum boldness, minimum calm — the diagonal must re-settle between sections or the page exhausts the visitor.
options.case: Fuses for energy and stands apart from every other portfolio; loses the product-clarity axis — a WordPress plugin at an impossible angle is drama, not proof.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably: dark gradient hero, big name, code motif, rounded cards.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
